tasks.label: Helpdesk: Start (python start.py)
tasks.detail: Starts the database, backend (:8000) and UI (:5280). No PowerShell required. Open http://localhost:5280

tasks.label: Helpdesk: Verify (python scripts/verify.py)
tasks.detail: Runs the full PASS/FAIL health check across every component.

tasks.label: Helpdesk: Seed demo data
tasks.detail: Creates roles, categories, the 4 demo users and the sample KB documents (idempotent).

tasks.label: Helpdesk: Stop (python start.py --stop)
tasks.detail: Stops the backend, frontend and bundled PostgreSQL.
